title: Make M5 composition no-PREPARE assertions observe PREPARE attempts
outcome: Make the no-PREPARE claim in the native provisioning-to-reference composition test falsifiable, without changing production authority or installer behavior.
acceptance: The composition either separately records PREPARE attempts and asserts no additional attempts during proof/reference/resolve/send, or explicitly narrows the asserted claim and documentation to INSTALL-only coverage.
A focused test check passes and the review evidence distinguishes observed PREPARE coverage from unchanged placement/intent counts.
